Name: Tales of the Aether Glade (TotAG)
Author: CodysOasis
Description:
[size=5][b]ABOUT[/b][/size]

[b]Tales of the Aether Glade (TotAG)[/b] adds a fully custom location hidden deep in the forest — and the ancient deity who tends it. It is the narrative spine and shared home of the TotAG mod series. Install it alone for the Glade and Vael. Install the expansions to see what else is living there.
[line]
[heading]WHAT THIS MOD ADDS[/heading]
[b][i]The Aether Glade[/i][/b]
A brand new custom location tucked away in the forest, with its own forage, atmosphere, and secrets.
[b]The Glade is introduced through a heart event with the Wizard at 2 hearts![/b]
Forage in the Glade is handled by [b]Farm Type Manager[/b], spawning unique seasonal items that can't be found anywhere else in the valley.

[b][i]Vael[/i][/b]
Vael is the keeper of the glade.
They are fully romanceable with a complete heart event arc, post-marriage content, and a small shop where they sell general magic supplies and utility potions.
Vael is not forthcoming. Getting to know them takes time and patience. What they respect is consistency.

[b]Vael's Heart Events (Spoiler Free):
[/b]
2 Hearts: Enter the glade
4 Hearts: Enter the glade between 8am-12am
6 hearts: Enter the glade between 8am-12am
8 hearts: Enter the Forest between 7pm-12am
10 hearts: Enter the glade between 8am-2am
Post-Marriage: Enter the Secret woods (Vael must be your spouse)

[i]Vael also features an unholy amount of regular dialogue![/i]
[line]
[heading]THE TOTAG SERIES[/heading]
TotAG is the foundation. The expansions each add their own story and content! Install only what you want, they are not requirements!

[b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45156]Vael's Familiars[/url][/i][/b]
Adds a roster of magical familiars from Vael's pack, powered by the FAUNA framework. Bond with them, care for them, and unlock their abilities over time. [b]Additional requirement:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46494]FAUNA[/url]

[b][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45282]Little Yuzuki[/url][/i][/b]
Adds Yuzuki, a spirit girl without a body, discovered by Vael. Help craft her a home, watch her grow, and eventually welcome her into your family. [b]Additional requirement:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36459]HaveMoreKids[/url] (for adoption)

[i]If you crave an easy way to one-click download everything at once, I have provided a handy dandy Complete Edition download in optional files![/i]
[line]
[heading]REQUIREMENTS[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley (latest version)[/*]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager (FTM)[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43167]Bog's Witchy Tilesheets[/url][/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]COMPATIBILITY[/heading]
[list]
[*]✅ Designed to coexist with most NPC and content expansion mods[/*]
[*]⚠️ May require compatibility patches for mods that heavily edit the Forest map[/*]
[*]❓ I have no idea how mobile modding works sorry[/*]
[*]❓ Report conflicts on the Bugs tab[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]CREDITS[/heading]
[b]Mod Design, Writing, Art:[/b] CodysOasis
[b]Special Thanks:[/b] The Stardew Valley modding community, SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Farm Type Manager documentation
[line]
[i]The Glade is waiting.[/i]
